# fusescope_rum_application (Resource)

A Real User Monitoring application. Creating one also creates its first public key, exposed as `key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fusescope_rum_application" "shop" {
  name        = "shop-web"
  platform    = "web"
  environment = "production"

  allowed_origins        = ["https://shop.example.com", "https://*.shop.example.com"]
  trace_propagation_urls = ["https://api.example.com"]
  sample_rate            = 0.5

  pii_policy = {
    query_allowlist = ["page", "sort"]
    require_consent = true
  }
}

# The public key goes into the browser SDK configuration.
output "shop_rum_key" {
  value     = fusescope_rum_application.shop.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

```terraform
resource "fusescope_rum_application" "android" {
  name                  = "shop-android"
  platform              = "android"
  environment           = "production"
  allowed_package_names = ["com.example.shop"]

  source_maps = {
    retention = "1y"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `platform` (String) `web` or `android`. Changing it replaces the application.

### Optional

- `allowed_origins` (List of String) Browser origins allowed to ingest, e.g. `https://shop.example.com` or `https://*.example.com`; `*` allows any. Web only.
- `allowed_package_names` (List of String) Android package names allowed to ingest, e.g. `com.example.shop` or `com.example.*`; `*` allows any. Android only.
- `pii_policy` (Attributes) What URLs keep before storage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pii_policy))
- `sample_rate` (Number) Fraction of sessions the SDK records, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 1.
- `source_maps` (Attributes) Source map and R8 mapping retention. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_maps))
- `trace_propagation_urls` (List of String) URL prefixes of APIs the SDK sends `traceparent` to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The application's first public key. The backend returns it only on create, so it is null after an import.
- `key_id` (String) ID of `key`.
- `org_id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--pii_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `pii_policy`

Optional:

- `drop_query` (Boolean) Drop query parameters that are not in `query_allowlist`. Defaults to true.
- `geo_lookup` (Boolean) Derive the country from the client IP. The IP itself is never stored.
- `hash_user_id` (Boolean) The SDK hashes the id passed to `setUser()`.
- `query_allowlist` (List of String) Query parameter names kept when `drop_query` is true.
- `require_consent` (Boolean) The SDK starts only after the consent hook allows it.
- `url_allowlist` (List of String) URL prefixes kept verbatim, query and fragment included.


<a id="nestedatt--source_maps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_maps`

Optional:

- `keep_newest_releases` (Boolean) Never delete the 3 most recently uploaded releases. Defaults to true.
- `retention` (String) Delete a release's maps when unused for this long: `30d`, `90d`, `1y` or `never`. Defaults to `90d`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# RUM applications are imported using their ID. The key is not readable, so
# `key` stays null after an import.
terraform import fusescope_rum_application.shop 0192a9c2-1234-7abc-8def-0123456789ab
```
